Pursuant to the bailable warrants executed against the respondent, he has appeared before the Court today.
2. He states that his lawyer is not available today.

However, he has been informed that the following compliances are still left in balance:
a.
An additional sum of Rs.40,000/- to be paid to petitioner in terms of settlement dated 7th January 2020, arrived at before the Delhi Mediation Centre, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi.

sentences.text:
This aspect was noted by the Division Bench in its order dated 9th February 2021 in MAT.APP.(F.C.) 8/2021;
b.

An amount of Rs.1 lakh is to be paid at the stage of quashing of FIR No.522/2016 under Sections 408/498A/34 IPC at Police Station Shakarpur;
c. FDR of Rs.2 lakhs in name of Baby Maanvi Aggarwal, which has to be transferred in the name of petitioner.
This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 29/06/2025 at 22:54:56 3.
As regards the first compliance, respondent shall pay Rs.40,000/- on or before 30th June 2025.

4. As regards the second compliance of Rs.1 lakh, to be paid at the stage of quashing of the Priya Aggarwal vs Radhey Shyam on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17441066/
1 aforenoted FIR, he shall take instructions in this regard as to when he can file for quashing of the FIR.

5. As regards the third compliance, two FDRs bearing No.36474049406 dated 21st January 2017 and No.36237101141 dated 07th November 2016, for Rs.1 lakh each, issued by the State Bank of India ('SBI'), Branch: Mayur Vihar - II, Delhi, the nomination of both these FDRs shall be transferred in the name of petitioner/wife as per the settlement.
6.

Copy of this order to be sent to the Manager, SBI Mayur Vihar-II, Delhi for information and compliance with the directions in paragraph 5 above, and thereafter, a new FD receipt shall be issued to the petitioner, at her request.

7. In the meantime, considering that respondent is unable to pay Rs.1 lakh yet, which is to be paid at the stage of quashing of FIR, the trial shall continue against the respondent, till this compliance is also done.

8. List on 29th August 2025.
9.
Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MAY 8, 2025/sm/tk
